legend: With a rush of people buying gifts for Valentine's Day, Magikarp is waiting in a line of n$$$n$$$ people at KarpMart when he notices that out of the n$$$n$$$ people in line, there are exactly k$$$k$$$ subarrays of length 4 where the people are lined up in increasing height order. Magikarp now wonders: if these n$$$n$$$ people were to rearrange themselves, how many total permutations would also have exactly k$$$k$$$ length-4 subarrays with increasing height order. Assume that all n$$$n$$$ people have different heights.
